ch01.title: Re: Starting from zero
ch01.nod: Every retry starts from zero. You keep what you learned.
body: I was somewhere between 12 and 15 when Minecraft stopped being just a game. I wanted to know how the worlds, the servers and the rules behind them actually worked.
With friends, I tried to set up our own Minecraft servers. None of them ever shipped.
They still counted. It was the first time I tried to build something for other people to use.
ch01.image: A Minecraft build from back then: a round hub in a lake with four paths leading out to the forest
